target: doctor.sh — prints a forge: section whose lines go through ok/warn/fail, and makes no forge call of its own
cmd:
. "$FIXTURES/forge/setup.sh"; fx_init
fx_gh auth_status 0 "Logged in"
unset FORGE FORGE_URL FORGE_REMOTE FORGE_TOKEN GITLAB_TOKEN
fx_remote https://gitlab.example.test/grp/proj.git
export FORGE_TOKEN=glpat-FAKE-not-a-real-token-0001
fx_http "GET /api/v4/user" 200 '{"username":"x"}'
fx_doctor
grep -q '^forge:' .doctor.out && echo header=yes || echo header=no
[[ -n "$FX_SEC" ]] && echo section_lines=yes || echo section_lines=no
echo "bad_lines=$(printf '%s\n' "$FX_SEC" | grep -Evc '^  \[(ok|WARN|FAIL)\] +.+')"
fx_done
